title.value: A HIGHLY ADAPTIVE ACOUSTIC MODEL FOR ACCURATE MULTI-DIALECT SPEECH RECOGNITION
title.justification: The title is clearly stated at the beginning of the paper, highlighting the development of a novel acoustic model for multi-dialect speech recognition.
title.quote: A HIGHLY ADAPTIVE ACOUSTIC MODEL FOR ACCURATE MULTI-DIALECT SPEECH RECOGNITION

analysis.description: The paper presents a novel approach to acoustic modeling for multi-dialect speech recognition. It introduces a single adaptive acoustic model that uses both dialect information and internal network representations to enhance recognition accuracy across multiple dialects. The model also incorporates a training strategy to handle unseen dialects.

type.justification: The paper provides experimental results on large-scale speech datasets to demonstrate the performance improvements of the proposed acoustic model.
type.quote: The experimental results on large scale speech datasets show that the proposed AM outperforms all the previous ones, reducing word error rates.
